speaker: そはら
jp: イカロスさんが笑うくらい、面白いギャグを\n言える人がいればねえ……
en: If only there was someone who could tell a gag funny enough to make Ikaros-san laugh...

speaker: 智樹
jp: まったく心当たりがないな……\n仕方ない、ここは自分でなんとかするか。
en: Can't think of anyone at all... Oh well, guess I'll handle it myself.

speaker: 智樹
jp: そはら、俺がボケたらツッコミを入れろよ。
en: Sohara, when I do the funny bit, you play the straight man.

speaker: そはら
jp: え……ええええっ！？\n私もやるの！？
en: Wh... whaaaat?! I have to do it too?!

speaker: 智樹
jp: なんだ？　お前がボケたいのか？\n天然ボケだもんな、そはらは。
en: What? You wanna be the funny one? I mean, you are a natural airhead, Sohara.

speaker: そはら
en: Who are you calling an airhead?!

speaker: 智樹
jp: グフッ……！　どつき漫才にしちゃ\n破壊力がありすぎねーか……？
en: Gwuh...! Isn't that a little too much firepower for slapstick comedy...?
